mentions.name: Puzzmallow
mentions.description: A puzzle site offering original logic and word puzzles. It features novel variants of classics like nonograms and sudoku, with twists such as hexagonal grids instead of square ones and new rules and concepts.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://puzzmallow.com
I build logic and word puzzles. I like to design original variants of classics like nonograms and sudoku - such as using hexes instead of a square grid, introducing new rules and concepts.
